data.narrative:
HLabs is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Paul Hetherington that has raised $5M+. The comparable universe comprises one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The stage-progression method is applicable and provides the primary valuation anchor. Using the $5M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a standard 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier yields an implied valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to an insufficient narrow peer set—while eight same-sector comparables exist, none satisfy tighter filters for identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range is constrained by reliance on a single method, making it sensitive to the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this particular company and stage. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently comparable seed-stage robotics firms for triangulation and whether HLabs' specific technology profile and capital efficiency justify multipliers at or above the median applied. A secondary financing round or updated revenue/traction metrics would meaningfully narrow this range.
